basic_info.description: 3BR/2.5BA Central Richmond home near GG Park. Open floor plan (remodeled 2019) with east/west exposure, great natural light, and amazing indoor/outdoor flow. 3 decks that overlook serene landscaped backyard. Deep lot 3000ft. Built in 1913 - original wood floors, box beam ceilings, gas fireplace. 2 car garage. Huge attic with pull down stairs. Expansion potential. Around the corner from Coffee Movement. Quiet block near restaurants, coffee, public transportation and the park.
